description: The boat sales or use tax rule yacht.loans has confirmed for a state from its statute or tax agency: rate, cap, exemptions or special tests (such as California's 12-month test or Florida's $18,000 cap), the citation, source URL and the date it was read. Omit state to list every state covered.

state.description: Two-letter state code or state name, e.g. FL or "New Jersey". Omit to list all covered states.
